headline: Exchange Intake Climbs To 1,561.7 Million Dollars From 1,250.9 Million, Led By Binance
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 trading venues climbed to 1,561.7 million dollars over 24 hours, from 1,250.9 million dollars at the previous reading. That figure is the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the rise means money arrived on exchanges, equal to 0.561 percent of the 278.6 billion dollars held there. Binance took in 495.7 million dollars, Bitget took in 250.6 million, Bitstamp took in 229.2 million, and Bitfinex took in 216.2 million, while BingX shed 38.9 million.
author: jordan
